ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Load via LSASS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a method to load DLL via LSASS process using an undocumented Registry key Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\NTDS\\\\DirectoryServiceExtPt.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\NTDS\\\\LsaDbExtPt.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\lsass\.exe" AND (Details = "\%\%systemroot\%\%\\system32\\ntdsa\.dll" OR Details = "\%\%systemroot\%\%\\system32\\lsadb\.dll")))
